# Živojin Sreckovic — portfolio (llms.txt)

> Web developer and AI automation specialist. Builds conversion-focused websites, landing pages, and acquisition systems (traffic → landing → conversion → automation → follow-up). Not template-heavy brochure sites—performance, structure, and revenue outcomes. Remote-first; works with businesses internationally.

Canonical origin for URLs below: **https://zivojin.dev** (update if you mirror this site elsewhere).

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://zivojin.dev/): Services, selected work preview, process, testimonials, pricing snapshot, approach.
- [About](https://zivojin.dev/about.html): Story, performance snapshot, approach, testimonials.
- [Work](https://zivojin.dev/work.html): Full project grid (corporate, fintech, real estate, e-commerce, agency, etc.). Each project card links to **Contact** to discuss that build (case pages are optional / not primary navigation).
- [Contact](https://zivojin.dev/contact.html): Inquiry form and email contacts.
